messages:
Evan Li: kicking off onboarding bench for newwave-11b — planning a quick smoke (seq=512, batch=1) then a full perf sweep (seq=128/512/2048, batch=1/4/8). Can infra provision 4xA100 for ~2h tomorrow?
Gina Chen: @Evan Li we have a 4xA100 slot at 10:00 UTC tomorrow, reserving now. Need tenant/affinity?
Evan Li: no special affinity, public pool is fine. tagging @priya for perf targets and benchmark config.
Priya Patel: thanks. Target SLOs: p50 < 70ms @batch=1 seq=128, p95 < 400ms @seq=2048 batch=1, and sustained throughput >= 40 tok/s for seq=512 batch=4. Also want peak memory number + kv cache growth.
Mateo Ruiz: adding a quick note — please run with kv_cache warm and cold (first token) to show cache effects. Also capture kernel timeline (nvprof/trace).
bench-bot: queued job id 83472 for newwave-11b. Command: 
```
run_bench --model newwave-11b --runs smoke,full --seqs 128,512,2048 --batches 1,4,8 --kv-warm --trace kernel --out /bench/83472
```
bench-bot: smoke run complete (id 83472-smoke). Summary: seq=512 batch=1 p50=62ms p95=210ms throughput=24 tok/s mem=31GB. Logs: /bench/83472/smoke/log.txt
Evan Li: smoke looks within baseline, nice. Priya — do you want any additional eval prompt sets?
Priya Patel: add a mix of short-chat + long-context summarization (5% long). Also collect sampling output for QA. If outputs diverge >2% on pass@1 vs reference we flag.
bench-bot: full perf sweep finished (id 83472-full). Key numbers:
- seq=128 batch=1: p50=48ms p95=120ms throughput=110 tok/s mem=30GB
- seq=512 batch=1: p50=64ms p95=230ms throughput=26 tok/s mem=32GB
- seq=512 batch=4: p50=85ms p95=300ms throughput=98 tok/s mem=33GB
- seq=2048 batch=1: p50=420ms p95=980ms throughput=6 tok/s mem=36GB
Flamegraph + kernel traces: https://bench.internal/83472/traces.html
Mateo Ruiz: quick look — that seq=2048 p50=420ms is over our p95 target. Could be kv cache thrash or attention kernel fallback. I'll pull the kernel timeline.
Gina Chen: infra note — we saw a transient host migration at 10:23:11, noisy neighbor I/O spike. I/O tail could affect long-seq. Checking host-level metrics.
bench-bot: kv-warm vs cold diff: cold-first-token latency increased ~1.9x for seq>1024, suggesting cold kv penalty. Detailed CSV: /bench/83472/kv_growth.csv
Evan Li: okay action items: Mateo to inspect kernel trace & kv behavior, Gina to confirm host migration impact and whether to re-run on a clean host, Priya to review QA outputs. Re-run only if infra says noisy neighbor caused regression.
Priya Patel: I pulled samples — sampling quality looks fine, pass@1 delta 0.7% vs baseline. Not concerned on quality side.
Mateo Ruiz: kernel timeline shows attention kernel falling back to slower path when sequence crosses 1536 tokens (fallback at t=1536). Looks like JIT didn't pick optimized kernel for that config. Will try forcing kernel override and re-run a targeted seq=2048 batch=1 test.
Evan Li: thanks. If forcing kernel fixes p50 -> rerun full 2048 check and update the bench page. If not, we may need to consider quantization swap or model sharding.
Gina Chen: re-run slot booked at 13:00 UTC on a clean host. I'll mark the original job with note about host migration.
bench-bot: re-run queued 83473 (seq=2048 batch=1, kernel_override=on).
bench-bot: re-run results (id 83473): seq=2048 batch=1 p50=210ms p95=450ms throughput=12 tok/s mem=36GB. Kernel override removed fallback. Trace: https://bench.internal/83473/traces.html
Evan Li: great, that confirms runtime kernel selection bug. Mateo — can you open a PR to prefer the optimized kernel for seq>1536 and add a unit test? Tag runtime-team.
Mateo Ruiz: will do, sending PR in ~30m. Summary note I'll add to bench page: initial run impacted by host migration + kernel selection; corrected with kernel override.
Priya Patel: marking this model as green for onboarding from perf perspective after the fix. I'll file the QA pass artifact under /models/newwave-11b/qa/2026-03-17. :tada:
Evan Li: awesome, thanks everyone. Closing thread after PR merges. :thumbsup:
